title: 3D-SceneQ: Empowering 3D LLM With Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning and Multi-Modal Feature Enhancement
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Published in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
summary: Current 3D scene understanding pipelines typically concatenate vast numbers of 3D object tokens with text tokens and feed the resulting sequence to a Large Language Model (LLM). However, existing 3D-LLMs for scene understanding encounter two major limitations: (i) excessive inclusion of task-irrelevant object data, introducing noise that reduces reasoning accuracy and increases hallucinations; and (ii) reliance solely on point cloud data, which inherently lacks the rich semantic information available in complementary 2D modalities, such as color, material properties, texture, and high-level contextual relationships. To address these challenges, we introduce 3D-SceneQ, a 3D LLM that unifies adaptive token pruning with multimodal semantic enrichment, markedly advancing scene understanding, reasoning, and grounding. Specifically, we propose a Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) module that adaptively selects task-relevant objects based on the intended meaning of user instructions, leveraging a learnable latent query to retain critical information while effectively suppressing irrelevant noise. In addition, we introduce a Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement (MOFE) module, which integrates 2D feature embeddings from pre-trained models into 3D representation to enrich object-level semantic information. Evaluations show that 3D-SceneQ outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks (e.g., +5.7 CIDEr on Scan2Cap and +17.0 EM@1 on SQA3D), demonstrating its remarkable capabilities in various 3D language reasoning tasks.

title: HDVS: semi-supervised semantic segmentation via heterogeneous dual-branch voting supervision
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Published in Visual Intelligence
summary: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation, which aims to utilize large volumes of unlabeled images to achieve accurate segmentation results with fewer human annotations, has attracted increasing attention. Prior methods were primarily based on the assumption that the pseudo-labels generated by each branch were sufficiently reliable to supervise the remaining branches. However, there is a concern that the errors in pseudo-labels could accumulate during co-training, potentially resulting in suboptimal performance. To this end, we present a novel framework called heterogeneous dual-branch voting supervision (HDVS), which is designed to enhance the reliability of pseudo-labels and mitigate the issues arising from pseudo-labeling. Specifically, based on the cross-supervision framework, we introduce a voting mechanism that correlates pseudo-labels from heterogeneous branches to produce pseudo-labels with enhanced reliability. Concurrently, we employ a feature communication module to introduce perturbations at the feature level in each branch to maximize prediction diversity across the dual branches while maintaining convergence. Comprehensive evaluations of the proposed HDVS on two benchmark datasets (PASCAL VOC 2012 and Cityscapes) demonstrate its superiority to the state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HDVS 半监督语义分割框架，在异构双分支交叉监督基础上引入投票机制融合两分支伪标签以提高可靠性，并用特征通信模块在特征层加扰动以维持分支预测多样性，在 PASCAL VOC 2012 与 Cityscapes 上评测。

title: GraphRAGProv: GraphRAG Meets How-Provenance
summary: GraphRAG systems often use knowledge graphs to retrieve relevant context for an LLM that produces the final answer. That makes answers more inscrutable and therefore less appealing for domains where transparency is paramount. We present GraphRAGProv, an architecture that executes SPARQL queries over source-grounded RDF graphs to compute answers and their how-provenance polynomials. These polynomials record which statement occurrences were used and how they were combined. Because each occurrence is linked to its source text, users can follow these links to check whether the extracted statements reflect the text and whether the query combines them to answer the question. Querying thereby becomes a way to inspect and evaluate the text-to-graph transformation. Our interactive demo examines 400 cases from two multi-hop QA benchmarks, revealing extraction and query errors even when the final answer is correct.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GraphRAGProv：在源文本锚定的 RDF 图上执行 SPARQL 查询，同时计算答案及其 how-provenance 多项式，记录使用了哪些语句出现以及如何组合，并回溯到原文本；交互式演示在 400 个多跳 QA 案例上揭示即使答对也存在的抽取与查询错误。

title: GradCO: Behavior-Aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
summary: Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) retrieves a target pedestrian using natural-language descriptions of appearance and normal or anomalous behavior. Unlike conventional text-based person retrieval, TPAS must preserve identity cues while distinguishing fine-grained behaviors. It presents two challenges: same-identity, different-behavior hard negatives cause gradient conflict during granular alignment, while strong appearance cues can obscure weak behavioral evidence during aggregation. We propose GradCO (behavior-aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading), comprising three complementary components. Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) forms appearance, normal-behavior, and anomalous-behavior streams whose roles are learned from retrieval objectives without expert-specific semantic labels. Conflict Offload Learning (COL) uses pair-conditioned offload anchors in similarity computation to reduce the conflicting-gradient burden on the main text representations. Hierarchical Intent Alignment (HIA) aggregates expert similarities and features using query-conditioned weights. Experiments on five TPAS/TIPR benchmarks show GradCO significantly surpasses SOTA methods and validate our design.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GradCO 用于文本行人异常检索，用行为感知 MoE 分出外观、正常行为与异常行为三条流，并以冲突卸载学习和查询条件加权的分层意图对齐聚合多路相似度，在五个检索基准上超过 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「强外观线索压制弱行为证据」及按查询加权聚合多专家表示的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、多 latent 假设加权与主导通路坍缩提供门控与聚合线索，可供核查，但该文属检索任务，未涉及推理期状态生成。

title: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
summary: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves higher mean performance than full evaluation in most settings while using approximately half as many evaluation cells.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 LLM 驱动的 agent scaffold 进化中评测预算应如何在「引导搜索」与「最终选择」两种用途间分配：实验发现稀疏反馈即可维持进化、额外定向评测更能改善最终选择，据此提出先以小规模全评测热身建立共享信息核心并校准项目参数固定的响应模型，搜索期用稀疏反馈，事后重拟合并用配对 successive halving 复用已有观测、只补缺失评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稀疏搜索反馈＋定向最终确认」的预算分配思路与 LVR 中评价、停止决策和实际成本的权衡结构相近，可供核查是否能用于 latent 推理候选的筛选与评测开销控制。

title: RPSD: Retrieval-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation with Optimal Transport
summary: Sequential recommendation predicts a user's next interaction from historical behavior. Recent LLM-based methods recast this task as generative recommendation and increasingly adopt reinforcement learning such as GRPO for post-training. However, these methods suffer from two limitations, namely credit-blind optimization, where a sequence-level reward is shared across all generated tokens, and collaborative-blind supervision, where each training signal is derived from a single user and ignores behavioral patterns shared across similar users. To address both issues, we propose Retrieval-Privileged on-policy Self-Distillation (RPSD). For credit-blind optimization, we introduce on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), in which a teacher with privileged knowledge re-evaluates the student's on-policy response, and the token-level confidence difference between the student and teacher reshapes the shared sequence-level advantage into token-specific credit. However, the privileged knowledge in vanilla OPSD is still derived from a single user, leaving collaborative-blind supervision unresolved. We therefore ground the teacher in collaborative behavioral evidence from similar users. Specifically, we use temporally aware optimal transport (OT) to compare interaction trajectories across users by jointly considering item similarity and temporal structure, and further apply diversity-aware selection to retain complementary trajectories as privileged evidence. In this way, on-policy self-distillation provides fine-grained token-level credit, while OT enriches the teacher with structured cross-user evidence. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to bring on-policy self-distillation to sequential recommendation and to use cross-user behavior as its privileged signal. Extensive experiments across multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that RPSD achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RPSD，用携带特权信息的教师重新评估学生的 on-policy 回答，以教师-学生 token 置信度差把序列级奖励重塑为 token 级信用，并借时序感知最优传输从相似用户轨迹中筛选跨用户证据作为特权信号，用于 LLM 序列推荐。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「置信度差重塑序列优势」的 token 级信用分配与检索式特权证据筛选，可供核查 LVR 训练中的贡献分配及外部/视觉证据如何进入监督，但本身不涉及多模态推理。

title: Taming Noise Initialization for Zero-shot Video Restoration with Image Diffusion Priors
summary: Recent advances in diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in restoring high-quality images in a zero-shot manner. Unfortunately, extending this success to video restoration is challenging due to the substantial computational resources required to pre-train video diffusion models. A rising trend seeks to address video restoration by utilizing a pre-trained image diffusion model, initiating restoration from either frame-wise independent or identical Gaussian noise. Yet, these approaches often fall short, as such simple noise initiations fail to capture and utilize the inherent temporal correlations within degraded video frames. In this work, we propose taming noise initialization for zero-shot video restoration, which preserves the intrinsic temporal correlations by generating initial noises directly using DDIM inversion on the corrupted video frames themselves. Building on this, we introduce an adaptive noise blending strategy that suppresses degradation patterns encoded during DDIM inversion while gradually steering the noise toward a Gaussian distribution. To further emphasize temporal consistency, we propose measurement-guided trajectory attention to better align features across frames. Extensive experiments on multiple video restoration tasks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing zero-shot approaches, consistently achieving superior results on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究零样本视频复原，提出直接用 DDIM inversion 在退化视频帧上生成初始噪声以保留时序相关，并引入自适应噪声混合与测量引导的轨迹注意力来抑制退化模式、强化跨帧一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由输入反演初始化噪声、再逐步回归高斯先验」及跨帧轨迹特征对齐的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态如何初始化、保留视觉证据并跨步对齐提供可供核查的方法线索，但原文属视频复原应用，与 LVR 主线的联系尚需判断。

title: Structured Representation Probing for Risk Anticipation in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving policies form structured internal representations of traffic, ego behavior, and road constraints. These representations offer a monitoring interface for anticipating failures, complementing risk signals from trajectories, controls, and manually designed features. We introduce the Structured Representation Probe (SRP), a lightweight monitor that reads actor, ego, and map representations from a frozen policy. SRP learns a separate linear risk direction for each source and aggregates element scores through cardinality-normalized log-mean-exp pooling, retaining sensitivity to salient evidence while reducing dependence on token count. Event-window supervision links the readout to upcoming hard failures, and auxiliary event type heads jointly train the source directions across failure modes. Online alerting uses a single generic score without modifying the driving policy. Bench2Drive experiments on DriveTransformer, UniAD, and VAD show higher frame-level PR-AUC and ROC-AUC than the evaluated runtime baselines. On DriveTransformer at a horizon of 2 seconds, ROC-AUC reaches 0.833 versus 0.715 for temporal consistency, with 2.67% readout runtime overhead. The trained probes also retain the ability to distinguish impending failures on new routes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出结构化表示探针（SRP），从冻结的端到端驾驶策略中读取 actor、ego、地图三类内部表示，为每个来源学习线性风险方向并以基数归一化 log-mean-exp 池化聚合，配合事件窗口监督与事件类型辅助头实现在线失效预警。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结策略内部表示上的线性探针 + 变长证据的归一并保留显著性池化 + 事件窗口监督」可为目标核查 LVR 中 latent 是否承载任务必要视觉证据、证据筛选与 token 数敏感性提供方法线索，但领域为自动驾驶，可迁移性尚待核查。

title: TimeLineXR: An Interactive Exploration of Time in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recently, it has been shown that vision-language models (VLMs) have a certain intrinsic understanding of time. They can estimate the temporal origin of objects and encode time along a low-dimensional, non-linear manifold inside their embedding space~\cite{tekaya2025matter}. That result is quantitative and reproducible, but the structure itself stays out of reach for end users: they cannot see it, query it with their own images, or inspect where a query lands relative to other years on the time axis. We present TimeLineXR, an interactive demonstration that turns this time axis into an explorable 3D scene. A web demo lets users upload or select images and see each placed on a color-coded 3D time axis; a Three.js WebXR scene renders the same time axis as a room-scale representation that can be grabbed, scaled, inspected, and queried by throwing image cards into it. Both clients run the same prediction pipeline against the same cached temporal index: encode the query with CLIP, project it through cosine-kernel KPCA, and snap it to the Bézier time axis. The system turns each image into a point on the time axis, so users can compare where different objects land and read off their estimated first year of appearance.Code source and reproduction steps can be found in: https://github.com/sterngefeuert/timeline-xr.

AI.brief_summary: TimeLineXR 是一个交互式演示系统，把 VLM 嵌入空间中隐含的时间轴做成可探索的三维场景：网页端与 Three.js WebXR 端共用同一流程，用 CLIP 编码查询图像、经 cosine-kernel KPCA 投影并吸附到 Bézier 时间轴，从而读出每张图估计的首次出现年份。
AI.relevance_reason: 其表示探测与非线性降维、轴对齐的投影流程可供核查，或可用于观察 latent 状态在概念轴上的落点与相对位置；但该工作只做静态时间属性的读出与可视化，不涉及推理期状态生成、证据使用或决策。

title: TRIDENT-Seq: Profile-Matched Prefix-Future Contrast for Label-Efficient Payment Risk Modeling
summary: Ant International accumulates large volumes of transaction history across users and payment businesses. Confirmed fraud and chargeback outcomes, by contrast, are scarce, delayed, and specific to each business. A single encoder pretrained on unlabeled histories could serve all businesses, but only if pretraining captures the behavior that separates risk. Coarse activity differences can make contrastive pretraining on transaction logs too easy: transaction volume, amount, and timing can distinguish a history's continuation from arbitrary candidates without modeling how payment resources are used. We present TRIDENT-Seq, a transaction foundation model trained with Prefix-Future Contrast (PFC). PFC matches each prefix to a summary of its subsequent behavior among candidates with similar activity profiles; activity prediction and dispersion regularization act on the encoder output. Across three production payment businesses, the pretrained encoder improves average precision (AP) and recall at a 0.5% intervention budget over architecture-matched scratch training in all six business-budget settings. With a fixed validation set, it exceeds full-label scratch training in mean AP and recall using 10% of the training labels on Wallet and 25% on Shopping and SME. Pretraining only on another business's histories still helps. Replacing profile-matched candidates with random ones cuts recall from 24.62% to 5.64%. In Ant International's deployment evaluation, recorded amount-based chargeback and overall loss rates are 37.7% and 37.9% lower than those of the previous XGBoost-based system under the same intervention budget.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TRIDENT-Seq，在交易日志上用「前缀—未来对比」（PFC）预训练编码器：将前缀与其后续行为摘要匹配，且候选按活动画像筛选，并辅以活动预测与分散正则，以在少标签条件下提升支付风控表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按画像匹配候选以削弱粗粒度捷径」与「前缀对标后续摘要」的做法，可能可供核查用于抑制 VLM 推理中的视觉旁路/浅层统计捷径，并训练真正追踪任务相关证据的 latent 状态。

title: LinMix: Data Mixing as Linear Domain Attribution
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale
summary: Language model performance depends strongly on the mixture of domains in the pretraining data corpus. Popular data mixing methods select these domain weights by training many small proxy models on random mixes and then fitting a regression model to predict performance from the mix. We recognize this practice as a domain attribution problem, where the regression measures each domain's contribution to the target metric. Through this lens, the standard Dirichlet sampling of proxy data mixes is a poor regression design that requires tuning and cannot support a linear fit for hundreds of domains. Building on classical optimal experimental design, we introduce LinMix, which samples mixes at the vertices of the capped simplex so that each domain is at its cap or absent. This hyperparameter-free vertex sampling decorrelates domain effects, enabling an interpretable linear model whose coefficients are the domain attributions. The optimal mix given by LinMix provably keeps only domains with positive attribution values and requires no search over candidate mixes. We further establish the optimality of vertex sampling, and prove that Dirichlet sampling inflates the attribution error when its mixes concentrate around the prior data mix. Pretraining experiments with 1B-parameter OLMo2 and 4B Qwen3.5 language models show that LinMix outperforms Dirichlet-based data mixing across reasoning, code, and math benchmarks, with relative gains of 46% on MBPP and 14% on GSM8K. At 288 fine-grained domains, only vertex sampling supports a linear fit, and LinMix improves benchmark accuracy by 11% on average over the best nonlinear baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 将预训练数据的域权重选择视为域归因问题，改用 capped simplex 顶点采样的代理混合，无超参地拟合线性模型，以系数作为各域归因并直接给出最优配比，在 1B/4B 模型上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用实验设计解耦相互关联的因素、再以回归系数做贡献分配的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉旁路、latent 轨迹等组件的贡献归因及内容/深度/位置混杂的解耦提供核查线索；但原文对象是纯文本预训练数据配比，迁移需较多核查。

title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can answer many factual questions correctly, but a correct answer is not necessarily a supported one. For an LLM agent, a knowledge graph (KG) plays two roles: as a source of answers, it supplies facts that the model lacks; as a source of evidence, it supplies the supporting triples that make an answer traceable and auditable. However, existing KG agents treat the KG only as a source of answers: their training data carries answers but not evidence, and their training rewards check the answer but not the retrieved evidence, so agents often answer correctly without retrieving the supporting triples. We propose FoG, a framework that trains KG agents to retrieve the evidence behind their answers. FoG consists of evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward (ECPR): the synthesis recursively hides explicit entities behind verifiable sub-questions, so that every question carries its supporting triples by construction; the agent records the triples returned by the KG; and ECPR credits each supporting triple to the turn that first retrieves it. Experiments on three KGQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG enables 3B--4B open-source agents to outperform substantially larger baselines in answer accuracy and evidence coverage, with zero-shot cross-KG transfer.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FoG 框架，用证据锚定的合成数据、KG 交互 agent 和证据覆盖过程奖励（ECPR），训练 KG agent 在作答时检索支撑三元组，并在三个 KGQA 基准上评估答案准确率与证据覆盖。
AI.relevance_reason: 把每条支撑三元组的奖励记到首次检索它的轮次这一 ECPR 做法，可供核查多轮视觉证据筛选与「LOOK」轮次的贡献分配和停止决策；但原文为纯文本 KGQA，迁移到视觉状态需较多改造。

title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated strong performance in LLM post-training. However, it allocates a uniform rollout budget to every training question, ignoring variations in question difficulty. As a result, highly difficult questions may receive too few rollouts to generate informative positive reward signals, limiting their contribution to training, while moderately difficult questions often receive more rollouts than necessary. In this work, we formulate the problem of difficulty-aware rollout budget allocation to maximize training utility under the same total rollout budget as standard GRPO. We propose AdaRoll-GRPO, which reformulates rollout allocation as a sequential decision-making problem and leverages a Bayes-adaptive Markov decision process (MDP) to learn an adaptive allocation policy. The learned policy is computed offline and applied during GRPO training without introducing additional online optimization overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning datasets and LLM architectures demonstrate that AdaRoll-GRPO consistently improves GRPO training performance under a fixed rollout budget, highlighting the effectiveness of adaptive rollout allocation for GRPO in LLM post-training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 GRPO 中每题 rollout 预算的分配建模为顺序决策问题，用 Bayes-adaptive MDP 离线学习难度自适应的分配策略 AdaRoll-GRPO，在总预算不变下提升推理训练效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按题目难度动态分配采样预算」的策略学习与离线应用方式，可能可供核查 LVR 中多步 THINK/LOOK 的动态计算分配与 STOP 停止决策，但文中无视觉证据或 latent 状态内容。

title: How Reliable Is Individualized Functional-Network Attribution in Resting-State fMRI Cognitive Prediction in ADNI?
summary: Individualized attribution estimates which functional networks drive a model prediction for a given subject and is often proposed as an interpretable resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) biomarker, but its test-retest reliability is rarely quantified. We evaluate per-subject network-ablation attribution for a frozen resting-state functional connectivity (FC) predictor (Schaefer-200 FC predicting MMSE/ADAS-Cog13) trained on N=875 subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), using, and (iii) a subject-level permutation null. Split-half reliability is near-ceiling (Spearman p=0.948/0.950) but drops on scan-rescan (p=0.609/0.616). Under the mismatched-subject null, correlations remain substantial (p~0.46-0.47), indicating strong population-shared structure, yet matched pairs exceed this null (z~6.6-6.9, p<=10-4). Thus, in ADNI, individualized network attribution contains a modest but non-zero person-specific component atop a strong population-shared pattern. We recommend reporting scan-rescan reliability together with a permutation-null control, rather than within-session proxies alone, to avoid overstating individual specificity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 ADNI 静息态 fMRI 上评估冻结功能连接预测器（Schaefer-200 FC 预测 MMSE/ADAS-Cog13）的逐被试网络消融归因是否可靠，比较分半信度、扫描重测信度与错配被试置换零假设，发现归因由强群体共享结构主导、仅含少量个体特异成分。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「重测信度＋置换零假设」评估协议可供核查 LVR 中归因与贡献分配是否真反映个别样本的证据而非通用模式，但领域远离视觉语言推理，迁移有效性需自行验证。

title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
summary: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on instruction data can quietly erode their safety, even when no training example looks harmful. Because this safety-degrading data looks benign, standard content filters struggle to catch it. We tackle this problem by developing SimpleLoRIF, a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior. By simplifying a low-rank attribution method and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, SimpleLoRIF can embed datasets on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool into a practical filter for full post-training datasets. We first validate it on emergent misalignment, where we find that gradients can connect insecure-code training data to the broadly harmful behaviors that appear after fine-tuning, with AUC as high as 0.865 in the gradient space of misaligned models. We then use SimpleLoRIF to build SafeTulu, a version of Tulu 3 with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe responses removed. Training on SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, outperforming both LLM-as-a-judge and prior gradient-based filtering, while largely preserving or even improving capability. Finally, we analyzed the removed data and identify possibly under-studied sources of safety degradation, such as tool-execution failures and narrative arithmetic. We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu to fine-tune on, such as by changing the removal fraction or filtering only certain subsets.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SimpleLoRIF，一种简化的低秩梯度归因嵌入方法，通过只回传最后四个 transformer 块的梯度来规模化筛选与不安全行为梯度对齐的微调样本，并用它构建移除 20% 高风险样本的 SafeTulu 数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文的梯度数据归因与贡献分配线索，或可供核查用于判断哪些训练样本真正促成 latent 推理行为，但研究对象是纯文本 LLM 的安全数据过滤，与视觉推理无直接关联。

title: ALADDIN: Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Face swapping transfers a source identity onto a target image while preserving the target's pose, expression, hair, and lighting. The most realistic current methods are diffusion-based, but they need many network evaluations per image. GAN-based methods are fast, yet trained from scratch they must learn realism from the adversarial signal alone and produce visibly weaker results. We present ALADDIN (Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping), a one-step face swapper obtained by initialising the generator from a pre-trained multi-step flow-matching model and training it adversarially under identity and target-preservation constraints. We expose a controllable trade-off between identity transfer and target-attribute preservation by training a student model with triplet pseudo-label supervision. We additionally identify a bias in the standard evaluation protocol, which favours methods trained against the same identity encoder used to score them, and re-evaluate all baselines with an independent one. ALADDIN is state-of-the-art among one-step methods in realism and target preservation at comparable identity transfer, and matches the best multi-step model with 28 times fewer network evaluations and an order of magnitude fewer training pairs.

AI.brief_summary: 将预训练多步 flow-matching 人脸交换模型蒸馏为一步生成器，用对抗训练加身份与目标属性约束，并以三元组伪标签实现身份迁移与属性保持的可控权衡；同时指出用训练时同一身份编码器评分会使该类方法被偏袒，并用独立编码器重评基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 人脸交换属图像生成，与 VLM 推理主线无直接关系；但多步迭代蒸馏为单步的做法可供核查迭代步数与推理状态质量的关系，「用训练所用编码器当评测器」的协议偏差也可能启发 LVR 中「latent 内容是否真被使用」的评价设计。

title: Orthogonal and Parametrized Multi-Attribute Steering of LLMs
summary: Activation steering offers an effective and efficient way to modify an LLM's behavior at inference time. However, it remains unclear how to apply steering such that the signal is consistently strong and the steering strength has a universally interpretable meaning. We address this first by identifying the most steerable interval for each steering vector and rescaling the steering range accordingly. Building on this, we introduce a more interpretable method for steering, called parameterized steering which instead of pushing activations in a direction, it sets them at the desired trait strength. Next, with multi-trait steering, we find that naively combining vectors causes them to interfere with one another. In response, we develop a method to orthogonalize the vectors; it decouples these traits, allowing a model to exhibit one behavior without inducing the others, thus enabling multiple traits to be steered simultaneously.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究 LLM 的激活引导：先为每个引导向量定位最易引导区间并重标定强度，提出直接把激活设为目标特质强度的参数化引导，并用正交化解耦多特质向量以支持同时引导。
AI.relevance_reason: 其激活干预与正交解耦或可作为核查 LVR 内部状态因果作用的工具（例如检验视觉细节等 latent 内容是否真正影响答案），但仅限纯文本、无推理过程评价，迁移可行性待核查。

title: GTFormer: A Syntax-Free Graph Network Alternative to Transformers for 8192$\times$ Length Extrapolation in Linear Time
summary: Self-attention mechanisms have established the Transformer as the dominant backbone across natural language processing, source code intelligence, and automated theorem proving. However, all-to-all pairwise token comparison enforces a quadratic $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ compute and memory barrier alongside severe softmax attention dilution as sequence length $N$ scales beyond the training horizon. Inspired by recent advances in algebraic graph learning (\textbf{WPNet}), this work introduces \textbf{GTFormer}, a syntax-free hierarchical Graph Neural Network (GNN) that replaces flat self-attention for general long-context sequence modeling. GTFormer organizes raw token streams into a bounded-degree hierarchy combining a balanced binary reduction tree ($\lceil \log_2 N \rceil$ depth), horizontal boundary-bridging shift edges, random expander shortcuts, multi-channel convex highway gating, and a top-down broadcast pass. Across eight long-context code, log, and multi-hop retrieval benchmarks trained exclusively on sequences of length $N \le 512$, GTFormer extrapolates zero-shot to $N = 4{,}194{,}304$ ($8192\times$) on a single commodity GPU in linear $\mathcal{O}(N)$ memory, maintaining near-perfect accuracy where standard and RoPE Transformers suffer from out-of-distribution attention collapse and out-of-memory exhaustion.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GTFormer：以无句法的分层 GNN（平衡二叉归约树、边界桥接偏移边、随机 expander 捷径、多通道门控与自顶向下广播）替代平坦自注意力，在仅 512 长度上训练后以线性时间与内存零样本外推到 4M token 的长上下文代码、日志与检索任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其有界度层次结构与线性状态传递实现长度外推，可能为 LVR 中预测工作区的长度泛化和结构化状态更新提供可供核查的架构线索，但论文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，也无 latent 推理状态。

title: GroundControl: Satellite-Conditioned Multi-View Diffusion for Reconstruction-Free Novel View Synthesis
summary: Multi-view or video diffusion models have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for novel-view synthesis from sparse image collections. While they can produce high quality images, they tend to hallucinate unrealistic spatial layouts when synthesizing views outside the input views (scene extrapolation). We propose to address this challenge for outdoor scenes by using satellite images as an additional information source to condition the multi-view generative model. We introduce a new satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model that combines conditioning from a satellite image and street-level input images when generating novel-views. Our cross-attention based conditioning allows us to retain pretrained multi-view diffusion priors to generate seamless, realistic, novel views from a handful of source views, while also adhering to the scene layout as seen from satellite images. Our model does not use 3D scene reconstruction, and only relies on posed street and satellite views. Our experiments on outdoor datasets show that our model is better than both satellite-conditioned or street-view conditioned baselines on novel-view synthesis, especially on challenging cases where target views have very little overlap with source views. Project page: https://nianticspatial.github.io/groundcontrol

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GroundControl，用卫星图像与街景输入图像共同条件化多视图扩散模型，通过 cross-attention 注入卫星视角的场景布局先验，在不做三维重建的情况下缓解外插视角的空间幻觉。
AI.relevance_reason: 多视图图像生成本身不在主线上，但其「保留预训练扩散先验、再以 cross-attention 引入额外全局证据以纠正幻觉」的做法，可能为 LVR 中如何把视觉证据注入内部状态而不破坏原有表示提供可核查线索。

title: Collective Dynamics of Self-Reinforcement: How Cross-Task Coupling Drives Policy Collapse in Unsupervised RLVR
summary: Label-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rewards a language model for agreeing with its own majority vote. It improves reasoning at first but eventually collapses: the self-assessed reward goes to one while accuracy falls, often until the model gives the same answer to every problem. The collapse appears only when training uses many problems. We explain this dataset-size dependence as a collective instability. In a solvable many-problem model in which problems share parameters, a population whose problems prefer different answers amplifies any shared perturbation for as long as the population-averaged slope $\langle F'\rangle$ of the single-problem self-reinforcement drift $F$ is positive. This holds while problems are still uncertain about their answers. Per-problem sharpening, slowed by $1/N$ for $N$ training problems, races against the shared mode, which grows at a rate $\proptoλ^2$ independent of $N$, where $λ$ is the strength of the shared coupling. This yields a critical number of problems $N_c\simeq\ln(1/δ)/(λ^2G)$, where $δ$ seeds the shared mode and $G$ decreases with the initial confidence. Simulations of the model confirm the predictions: a sharp transition, $N_c\proptoλ^{-2}$ up to a logarithmic correction, a single critical amplification $λ^2NG$ across couplings, confidence profiles and training variants, a logarithmic dependence on batch size, and no collapse for confident initial models. A kernel version of the theory identifies a protective coupling (generalization of sharpening) and a marginal-entropy bonus that stabilizes the uniform collective mode. In label-free RL of a small Transformer, removing the shared direction prevents collapse entirely, restoring it causes collapse, and collapse grows with training-set size and base-model entropy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究无标签 RLVR（奖励模型与自身多数投票一致）中准确率最终崩塌的现象，提出多问题共享参数的集体不稳定性模型，推导出临界问题数 N_c∝λ⁻²，并用模拟与小型 Transformer 实验验证共享方向驱动崩塌、剔除该方向即可避免，边际熵奖励可稳定均匀模式。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本训练动力学研究，但其自强化崩塌与共享模式放大、以及边际熵正则的分析，可供核查自奖励或自洽监督训练推理模型时的信号同质化与多样性维持问题，可能提示训练规模与正则设计的联系。

title: Understanding the limits of latent world models
summary: World models are widely proposed as core components for enabling agents to reason over long temporal and spatial horizons. Yet current evaluations often emphasize task performance while providing limited insight into whether learned world models acquire predictive latent dynamics that reflect the underlying structure of the environment. Here we introduce the concept of faithful latent world models as an equivariance condition between the environment's transition map and the learned latent dynamics. We propose latent rollout consistency (LRC) as a metric to evaluate action-conditioned latent prediction. Strikingly, we find that across the studied state of the art latent world models, none solves the task by actually faithfully modeling the dynamics of the environment.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把「忠实潜在世界模型」刻画为环境转移映射与学得潜在动力学之间的等变条件，提出 latent rollout consistency（LRC）指标评估动作条件下的潜在预测，并据此发现所研究的一流世界模型都未真正忠实建模环境动力学。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以等变性与 rollout 一致性检验潜在状态是否真正承载转移结构而非仅拟合任务表现的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态是否忠实保留任务必要信息、性能收益是否来自真正的潜在推理。

title: GAS-PFN: Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Zero-Shot Traffic Forecasting
summary: Traffic forecasting requires modeling complex temporal dynamics and the spatial dependencies imposed by road topology. Supervised graph-based models achieve strong performance, but are often trained for a particular dataset and sensor graph, making deployment to new or evolving networks costly. Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) offer a zero-shot alternative by learning in-context inference from synthetic task priors, which provide an explicit mechanism for encoding domain-specific assumptions. Existing forecasting PFNs, however, do not explicitly represent the graph-structured dependencies governing traffic dynamics. To combine graph-aware traffic modeling with zero-shot adaptation, we introduce the Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Network (GAS-PFN). GAS-PFN incorporates sampled road topology into its synthetic task prior through random-walk diffusion, teaching the model to learn graph-coupled dynamics during pretraining. Its co-designed inference architecture uses two mask-conditioned passes through a shared Transformer backbone to separately model sensor-specific temporal dynamics and spatiotemporal interactions among neighboring sensors before integrating their representations for prediction. This design enables GAS-PFN to use target-network structure and context without parameter updates. Across six benchmarks at the 90-minute horizon, GAS-PFN reduces MSE by 34.0% on average relative to TimePFN, its closest PFN-based predecessor. It also reduces MSE by 27.7% on average relative to four recent industry-developed general-purpose zero-shot forecasters. In this comparison, all models receive 90 minutes of contiguous recent history, and any additional context is drawn from each dataset's chronological training split. These results indicate that aligning PFN priors and inference architectures with graph structure improves in-context learning for zero-shot traffic forecasting.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 GAS-PFN：将采样得到的道路拓扑经随机游走扩散注入合成任务先验，使预训练阶段学到图耦合的动态；推理时用同一 Transformer 主干做两次掩码条件前向，分别处理单传感器时序与邻域时空交互，再融合表示，从而无需参数更新即可适配新传感器网络做零样本交通预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不研究视觉或多模态推理，但其「以合成任务先验显式编码领域假设」和「共享主干两路掩码条件、分离局部动态与邻域交互」的设计，可能为 LVR 的训练先验构造与内部状态分解提供可核查的借鉴线索。

title: EnvSched: Environment-Aware Scheduling for Rollout-Efficient Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: As executable environments for language agents scale, generating and verifying their rollouts becomes increasingly expensive. Under finite rollout budgets, this raises an important question: can data management at the environment level make agentic reinforcement learning (RL) more efficient by organizing, evaluating, and scheduling task instances together with the environments that determine their tools, states, transitions, and verification? To address this question, we introduce EnvSched (Environment-aware Scheduling), an online scheduler that learns from rollout history. EnvSched assigns scheduling value through two complementary modeling choices: exploitation prioritizes tasks likely to provide informative reward differences, while coverage spreads each batch across underobserved environments and interaction patterns. EnvSched organizes environment--task pairs as nodes in a dual-relation graph, with within-environment edges capturing task semantics and shared tool, state, and verifier structure, and cross-environment edges capturing abstract execution and reward topology. By propagating historical rollout statistics along both edge types, it predicts within-task reward variance. These predictions guide a scheduler that allocates each batch to tasks with high predicted reward variance and underobserved environments and tasks. Environment quotas and a similarity penalty further limit concentration and redundancy, yielding informative and diverse batches without additional pilot rollouts. In RL on Qwen3-8B, EnvSched achieves an average score of 48.81 across BFCL-v3, tau-Bench, and ACEBench-Agent after 40 training steps, exceeding the highest score attained by random task selection after 120 steps. It also improves downstream performance across model sizes at the same training budget.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 EnvSched，一个面向语言 agent 强化学习的在线调度器：将环境—任务对组织为双关系图，沿环境内与环境间边传播历史 rollout 统计以预测任务内奖励方差，再结合环境配额与相似度惩罚，把有限 rollout 预算分配给信息量高且覆盖不足的任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预测奖励方差以挑选高信息量样本、并用覆盖度约束抑制冗余」的调度思路，可能可供核查如何为 VLM 推理的轨迹训练与视觉证据筛选分配采样预算；但论文本身不涉及视觉输入或 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行判断。

title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
summary: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CrossProfile 诊断基准，用 60 个模板、480 个任务交叉事实归属与固定文本，检验隐藏画像任务中按稀有性或相关性压缩群体讨论记忆为何失效，并揭示决策模型对多智能体归属标签的社会证明偏置。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「记忆应保留哪些证据」及相关性筛选引入 decoy、归属标签影响决策的发现，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、信息坍缩与贡献分配；但属纯文本多智能体场景，迁移需验证。

title: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Cross-View Temporal Object Correspondence
summary: Cross-view object correspondence identifies the same object across views. However, existing methods often rely on frame-wise matching or sequential tracking, which can propagate correspondence errors under appearance changes or occlusions. Therefore, we introduce cross-view temporal object correspondence, which requires preserving object identity across both views and time from a query mask. To address this, we propose XTrack, a unified framework which repurposes a pretrained video DiT with semantic and spatiotemporal priors for RGB-to-mask latent transport, jointly modeling cross-view matching and temporal tracking. However, naive video DiTs do not guarantee accurate cross-view grounding and often attend to semantically similar yet incorrect objects across views. Thus, we introduce focal cross-view attention alignment, hard negative conditioning, and local context crop strategies to ensure reliable grounding. Finally, beyond these architectural enhancements, we also tackle the lack of dense annotation by introducing a pseudo-label curation pipeline that converts sparse Ego-Exo4D annotations into dense supervision to enable effective video-level training. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of XTrack as a unified framework, ensuring robust temporal consistency and identity preservation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 XTrack，复用预训练视频 DiT，把跨视角匹配与跨时间跟踪统一为从查询掩码出发的 RGB-to-mask latent transport，并借助焦点跨视角注意力对齐、难负样本条件、局部上下文裁剪及伪标签稠密化，保证跨视角定位与身份保持。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 latent transport 与注意力对齐、难负样本约束可能为 LVR 中保留任务相关视觉证据、抑制「语义相似但错误」的干扰提供可供核查的线索；但任务属视频对应与跟踪，未涉及推理期状态生成或停止决策。

title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
summary: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Heads of Security（HoS），用少量可学习的 per-head attention gate 在可信与不可信 token 间重分配注意力，实现指令-数据分离；在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 与 GPT-OSS-20B 上与 SecAlign++、ASIDE 比较抗提示注入鲁棒性和通用效用。
AI.relevance_reason: 按头学习注意力门控以区分信源，可能为 VLM 中视觉证据筛选、抑制视觉旁路或按需使用图像 token 提供可核查的门控监督线索；但该文不含多模态 latent 推理状态，联系需较多核查。

title: KORA: Deterministic-First Execution Control for AI Workloads
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and benchmark available at https://github.com/Krako-Labs/KORA
summary: AI applications often invoke a model before they determine whether inference is necessary. That default is useful for ambiguous generative tasks, but it is poorly matched to work that is structured, deterministic, policy-bound, lookup-oriented, or directly verifiable. KORA introduces deterministic-first execution control: a pre-inference control layer that represents requests as task paths, attempts deterministic or structured routes first, validates route outcomes, records telemetry, and escalates to a model-candidate path only when deterministic handling is insufficient. This paper presents KORA as a deterministic-first execution-control architecture and reports bounded evidence from reproducible benchmark and validation workloads. In a reproducible 100-task deterministic-heavy benchmark, KORA-controlled execution avoided 80 of 100 simulated model invocations versus a naive direct baseline, with zero mismatches in the deterministic subset. The workload is intentionally deterministic-heavy: it includes categories such as FAQ lookup, policy/rule checking, schema or format validation, deterministic transformation, and a smaller set of model-needed ambiguous or generative tasks. A separate synthetic customer-support local/no-network validation workload demonstrates route measurement and avoided model-call accounting in an application-shaped setting. These results support bounded model-invocation reduction and validation visibility in documented workloads. They do not establish production behavior, real-provider outcomes, energy outcomes, API-cost reduction, or broad superiority.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 KORA，一种在调用模型前进行「确定性优先」执行控制的架构：将请求表示为任务路径，先尝试确定性或结构化路由，验证路由结果并记录遥测，仅在确定性处理不足时升级到模型路径；在 100 个确定性偏重任务的可复现基准上避免了 80 次模拟模型调用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先判断推理是否必要、必要时才升级」的门控与成本核算思路，与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止决策和计算价值判断有概念联系，可能为门控设计提供线索；但该工作属系统路由层，不涉及推理状态或视觉证据，需核查可迁移程度。

title: Physiognomy Revisited: How Vision-Language Models Encode Sensitive Attributes Through Image Transformation
summary: Emergent generative AI technologies, while remarkably beneficial across several tasks and domains, can suffer from unforeseen vulnerabilities and difficult-to-anticipate failure modes. Such failure modes can disparately affect vulnerable communities. This paper investigates two well-known vision language models (VLMs) and inspects how these models encode protected identities while generating images. We show that when VLMs are requested to transform human face images to reflect race identities (e.g., Hispanic, Black, White, or Asian) and sexual orientation (e.g., gay or straight), VLMs often comply with such requests. We demonstrate that compliance (and refusal) is non-deterministic, group-sensitive, and generated images are statistically distinguishable, often accentuating deep-seated stereotypes. We further show that representation biases introduced during image generation can re-emerge in textual reasoning and characterization tasks. Finally, we show that this worrisome finding is not limited to racial identity or sexual orientation, image generation can perpetuate bias around criminality, raising concerning possibilities of AI-assisted profiling.

AI.brief_summary: 论文审计两个 VLM 在人脸图像变换任务中对种族、性取向等敏感属性的编码与顺从/拒绝行为，发现合规性非确定、群体敏感、生成图像带有刻板印象，且这类表示偏差会回流到文本推理与人物刻画任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「表示偏差在生成后回流到文本推理」的观察，可能可供核查 latent 视觉状态是否携带任务无关属性并污染后续推理判断；但论文重心是公平性审计，未涉及 latent 状态生成或停止决策机制。

title: Counting the Bandages: On measuring the time that AI saves
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Replaces the author's earlier TSB proposal (SSRN 6682338). Code and data: https://github.com/solomonshalom/tsb-bench. Also archived on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.23557773
summary: I consider what it means for AI assistance to save time. I contrast a stopwatch view, on which time saved is whatever the clock records, with a ledger view, on which it is a counterfactual that has to be read next to the errors the work lets through, and I argue for the latter. The argument has four parts. I define a model-free pair of quantities, time saved and excess escaped defects, and one decision number built from them: the break-even defect cost. I give a baseline model of checking in which, until the model is good enough not to check, a calibrated worker's escaped-defect rate does not depend on how good the model is; checking time grows with the logarithm of the model's error rate; and over-trust buys minutes on the clock at a larger cost in total minutes. I show what randomized studies can and cannot identify, and I replicate METR's developer study from its public data: the same 246 issues support a slowdown of 19% or 24% depending on the estimand (34% without adjusting for a chance imbalance), and AI helped on somewhere between 3% and 82% of them. Finally, I restate the published record, with stated bounds in place of imported point assumptions. In GDPval's own review-every-output workflow, review time alone caps GPT-5's speedup at 3.6x; the consultants outside the frontier were faster, and more often wrong. Last, I test two of the model's predictions in a small pre-specified experiment on AI reviewers checking AI drafts of the same kind of brief, built from SEC filings made after the models' training data were collected. Told the drafter's true error rate, the reviewer checked more as it rose, but all-or-nothing, switching near where its prompt's costs break even. Told that the drafter erred ten times less often than it did, it checked 7 fewer of 9 figures and let a wrong figure through in 22.5% of briefs instead of none: faster and worse, entirely through reduced effort.

AI.brief_summary: 论文讨论「AI 节省时间」应如何度量，提出时间节省与逃逸缺陷这对无需模型假设的量及由此构造的盈亏平衡缺陷成本，给出检查投入的基线模型，并以公开数据重析 METR 开发者研究、用 AI 审稿人实验检验模型预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把检查投入与模型错误率、缺陷代价挂钩并给出停止阈值的做法，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本核算与停止策略设计提供问题表述与评价线索；但研究对象是人类开发者与文本审稿流程，非 VLM 内部状态，可迁移性需核查。

title: Curriculum-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Far-Range Rocket Landing
comment: This is the extension of our previous paper that got accepted in ICAART 2026
summary: Autonomous vertical landing of reusable launch vehicles is a critical yet formidable challenge in aerospace engineering, primarily due to highly nonlinear dynamics, stringent precision require- ments, and inherent environmental uncertainties. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional model-based control, existing approaches frequently rely on flat training paradigms and highly simplified initial conditions, drastically limiting their real-world applicability. This paper proposes a comprehensive curriculum-driven deep reinforcement learning framework designed to master both far-range navigation and precision landing. By employing a three-stage curriculum augmented with a critic warm-up procedure and a rehearsal mechanism to prevent catastrophic forgetting, alongside a high-dimensional observation vector utilizing a full 3 X 3 rotation-matrix, the agent is trained to navigate from an initial horizontal distance of 1,000 to 1,500 units vastly farther than prior benchmarks before executing a soft touchdown. Crucially, we intro- duce a redesigned reward function that reduces unnecessary computational overhead and addresses limitations of earlier formulations, including poorly calibrated reward components and potentially conflicting optimization objectives. The redesigned function bounds the per-step reward magnitude by (O(1)), while its progress term accumulates the total distance closed over the trajectory. The available 100,000-episode results report a 99.98% success rate for the proposed policy and 68.31% for the baseline under the evaluation conditions. In the evaluation, the proposed policy retained 69.1% of its initial fuel capacity and achieved a mean final distance from the pad centre of 7.07 units, compared with 13.10 units for the baseline. Landing visualizations are available in Video 1 and Video 2.

AI.brief_summary: 提出课程驱动的深度强化学习框架，以三阶段课程、critic 预热和 rehearsal 防遗忘机制，结合高维观测与重设奖励函数，完成远距离火箭垂直精确着陆。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作与视觉/多模态推理无直接关联，但三阶段课程与 rehearsal 防遗忘可能为长程 latent 推理的分阶段训练设计和早期能力保持提供可核查的训练调度线索。

title: Distributed LLM Inference via Communication-Efficient Speculative Decoding
summary: Distributed speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach for device--server collaborative large language model (LLM) inference, but its decoding speedup is often limited by the vocabulary-scale communication overhead. In existing distributed speculative decoding methods, exact rejection sampling requires transmitting full token distributions over the LLM vocabulary between the device and the server, which becomes costly in bandwidth-constrained environments. To address this issue, we propose DISCO, a communication-efficient framework for distributed speculative decoding, that eliminates vocabulary-scale distribution transfer while preserving the exact target distribution. DISCO achieves this by introducing a server-side replica of the draft small language model (SLM), which enables the server to locally obtain the draft-side distribution required for rejection sampling. As a result, DISCO exchanges only drafted token indices and scalar probability values between the device and the server. Experimental results on multiple datasets show that DISCO consistently achieves higher decoding speedup than existing distributed speculative decoding methods, particularly under stringent bandwidth constraints.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DISCO，在端—云协同的分布式 speculative decoding 中，通过在服务端复制草稿小模型使拒绝采样可在本地完成，只需交换草稿 token 索引与标量概率，从而去掉词表级分布传输并保持精确目标分布。
AI.relevance_reason: 草稿—验证范式与「不传输完整分布仍保持精确性」的协议设计，可能为 latent 推理步骤的低成本草稿生成与验证、以及跨设备协同推理的通信开销提供核查线索，但其与视觉证据或推理状态无直接联系。

title: Exponential Wake-Up Overshoot in Explicit Gaussian Point-Process Filters
comment: 26 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables; main text with Appendices A-G (proofs, experimental protocol, additional results). A four-page version has been submitted to IEEE Signal Processing Letters
summary: When events resume after a long silence, explicit Gaussian point-process filters amplify the first update exponentially in the silence duration. We give the exact distribution of this update and a computable index that predicts when it overshoots. For the explicit (single-scoring-step) filter and its implicit posterior-mode counterpart, we derive second-order silence expansions of the state variance with opposite-sign logarithmic corrections. The crossing index determines when the post-wake prediction exceeds the resumed rate, separating the bin width at which the amplification exponent reaches one from the larger width at which the true rate is overshot. At fixed bin width, the implicit filter's expected loss grows logarithmically with silence duration, whereas a continuous-time counterexample rules out a bound uniform in bin width and silence duration. Experimental evaluation confirms these predictions in all 73 crossing cells and on exchange trade data, while variance caps reduce explicit overshoot but mostly hurt the implicit filter.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究显式高斯点过程滤波器在长时间无事件后首次更新被按沉寂时长指数放大的现象，给出该更新的精确分布、可计算的越界指数与状态方差的二阶展开，并在 73 个交叉单元和交易数据上验证预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「沉寂时长放大单次状态更新」与越界指数，可能为 LVR 中证据稀疏或延迟到达时 latent 状态的更新强度与门控（何时 LOOK/STOP）提供类比与可核查的量化工具，但跨域迁移可行性尚需判断。

title: Data-driven Discovery of Lie Symmetries and First Integrals with Latent ODEs
summary: We present LatentLieODE, a novel neural ODE method to discover linear Lie symmetries and first integrals of the learned dynamics from timeseries observations such as video inputs. It starts with an autoencoder, which learns a low dimensional representation of the observed system and then maps trajectories to decorrelated latent coordinates $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$. A bank of linear infinitesimal generators $\mathbf{A}_k \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$ is fitted jointly against a differentiable Lie-bracket residual $\mathbf{J}_f(z)\mathbf{A}z - \mathbf{A} f(z)$, while an MLP optimises the latent ODE $f(z) = \mathrm{d}z/\mathrm{d}t$ to reconstruct the observation-space timeseries. After suitable generators and $f$ are found, we fit a third network $H_φ$ to generate the first integral of the system. Across six benchmark systems (harmonic oscillator, simple and twin pendulums, Lotka-Volterra, pixel pendulum, sphere geodesics) we find each system's relevant symmetries, and the discovered invariants match ground-truth conserved quantities at $|ρ| \geq 0.978$. On the sphere, the pipeline recovers a non-abelian $\mathfrak{so}(3)$, certified by the negative-definite Killing form of its recovered structure constants. This work presents significant advances in data-driven discovery of symmetries and provides a new pathway for neural surrogates of dynamical systems.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LatentLieODE：先用自编码器将视频等时序观测映射到去相关的低维 latent 坐标，再联合拟合线性 Lie 对称生成元与 latent ODE，并由第三个网络提取首次积分；在六个基准系统上恢复出对称结构与守恒量。
AI.relevance_reason: 用代数结构（Lie 生成元、不变量）约束 latent 状态及其演化，可能为 LVR 中结构化 latent 推理状态的设计与「latent 是否保留任务必要几何」的评价提供启发；但任务本身属动力系统发现，与多模态推理联系较远，线索需核查。

title: Exploratory creative pre-ranking: Hierarchical empirical-Bayes Thompson sampling for real-time creative optimization
summary: Dynamic creative optimization decides which creative of an ad to render for each request. Recent work places that choice before ad ranking, but relies on deterministic point predictors with no calibrated uncertainty. AI-generated content has made creatives nearly free, while feedback per creative remains sparse and selection faces a tight latency budget. We introduce a creative pre-ranker that scores every recalled creative and shortlists each campaign's pool before the per-user ranker runs. Creatives sit in a hierarchy of audience segment, advertised item, campaign and creative, so a cold creative falls back on what its parent levels have earned, and how much it borrows from its parents is set in closed form from historical logs, with one parameter per level and nothing tuned. To stay within the latency budget, the pre-ranker predicts for an audience segment rather than an individual user, from per-attribute counters. It selects by a single Thompson draw per creative, balancing exploration and exploitation so that a new creative still has a chance to be learned. Replaying Roblox Sponsored-ads traffic over campaigns with competing creatives, the shortlist lifts predicted play-through rate by 8.14% against 2.80% for an equally sized random shortlist, forwards more than 40% fewer creatives than the full pool, and adds only 0.2% to serving time. After an A/B test on live traffic, the method now serves in production at Roblox.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一个广告创意预排序器：用分层经验贝叶斯让冷启动创意回退到受众、商品、活动等父层级的历史统计，并以每个创意单次 Thompson 抽样在严格延迟预算内平衡探索与利用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「层级回退借力 + 单次 Thompson 抽样」提供了一种在紧延迟预算下做不确定性驱动探索—利用权衡的轻量方案，可能为 LVR 中候选筛选、计算预算分配与停止决策的不确定性建模提供核查线索，但领域距离较远。

title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
summary: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution through three roles: Creator, Explorer, and Evolver. Drawing on verified execution trajectories, Evolver shifts the basis of task organization from surface categories to shared requirements, reorganizing the original task tree into a hierarchical capability tree. We introduce Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real: for heterogeneous tasks at the same node, Creator abstracts their common requirements into simplified, verifiable simulated worlds for capability learning, while evaluation on original tasks measures transfer. Along this capability tree, Explorer progressively evolves reusable capability modules through selective inheritance, forming a Harness tree whose validated updates accumulate across iterations within a fixed topology. The resulting Harnesses specialize in different capabilities, motivating a Capability-Aware Harness Router that uses public task information to select compatible module configurations from the tree. Our evolved Harnesses improve mean performance by 34 points across 28 training benchmarks and 26 points across 18 unseen benchmarks, including two real-world embodied tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Trinity 递归自我改进框架，由 Creator、Explorer、Evolver 三个角色把按表层类别组织的任务树重组为共享能力树，将异构任务抽象为可验证的简化模拟世界以训练可复用能力模块（Harness），并用能力感知路由器按公开任务信息选择模块配置，报告在 28 个训练与 18 个未见基准上的平均提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按能力需求抽象任务并路由模块」的思路可能为 LVR 中按任务需求组合推理模块、动态分配计算提供参照，Real2Sim2Real 的简化可验证世界也可供核查任务必要信息如何被保留；但能力学习发生在外部模拟环境与脚手架层，与内部视觉状态表示无直接联系。

title: Scaling and Renormalization in Neural Networks: An Effective Renormalization-Group Description of Grokking
summary: Grokking is a delayed transition from memorization to generalization in deep neural networks (NNs). We examine whether scaling and renormalization group (RG) theories can describe this dynamics, establishing a quantitative physical framework for neural generalization transitions. For modular addition on a two-layer NN, an ensemble of trained models defines an order parameter (the squared weight norm) and fluctuation proxies for the heat capacity and the susceptibility, with training epoch and weight decay serving as thermal and field control coordinates. To bridge neural architectures to real-space RG, we construct an exact coupling matrix via a second-order expansion of the loss with respect to per-neuron norms and use its Fiedler vector to define an effective geometry. This spectral ordering yields a monotonic spatial decay of coupling strength that is absent under random permutations. We then execute real-space RG by block-spin aggregating adjacent neurons and parameterizing the coupling matrix into off-diagonal band strengths. Linearizing this local RG map yields relevant scaling exponents and five derived critical exponents, with direct empirical estimates matching RG predictions within 1-10%. Overall, our framework provides a consistent effective description of grokking, suggesting the scaling and renormalization group formalism as a tool to investigate NN dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用标度与重整化群框架刻画两层网络在模加法任务上的 grokking：由模型集合定义序参量与涨落代理量，借损失对神经元范数的二阶展开构造耦合矩阵，用其 Fiedler 向量给出有效几何并做块自旋粗粒化，线性化局部 RG 映射得到临界指数，与实证估计吻合在 1–10% 内。
AI.relevance_reason: 重整化粗粒化与由耦合谱导出的有效神经元几何，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的层级抽象、表示几何与状态合并评价提供借鉴线索，但论文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，其可迁移性尚需核查。

title: Any3R: Feedforward 3D Reconstruction from Any Camera Type
summary: Geometry foundation models recover camera poses and dense geometry from a set of images with a feed-forward network, but they expect pinhole images. That assumption is inside the backbone too: the positional encoding and the training loss both bind an image position to a direction in space, and both depend on the lens. We condition both on the dense ray field, the unit direction through every pixel, which describes any central camera without a lens type, distortion coefficients or a bound on field of view. Angular coordinates give the rotary encoding the measured ray angle of each patch, evaluated per view, and solid-angle weighting scales the point loss by the area each pixel covers on the sphere, so neither the encoding nor the supervision depends on the lens. Any3R is therefore a feed-forward model that takes any central camera, and is robust to mixing many camera types per scene, with no retraining per lens. On a benchmark of thirteen central cameras across three datasets, where every method reconstructs with its own predicted camera poses, it is the most consistently accurate method. Any3R enables scalable 3D reconstruction from heterogeneous crowdsourced and archival imagery collections sourced across diverse camera types. Project page: https://jingong-chen.github.io/Any3R/

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Any3R，将前馈三维重建模型的位置编码与训练损失都改为条件于逐像素稠密射线场（角度坐标与立体角加权），使单个模型可直接处理任意中心相机类型而无需按镜头重训。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以相机无关的几何量（射线方向、立体角）替代镜头相关的位置/权重」思路，可能与 VLM 内部状态中如何保留几何与视角相关信息、以及跨视角表示一致性可供核查，但属三维重建领域，与 LVR 推理过程无直接联系。

title: Dynamical coarse-graining of neural-network training
summary: Dynamical coarse-graining of neural networks gives macroscopic observables and enables training to be predicted, and controlled in a state space far smaller than the parameter space. In this paper, we first define the learning operator following the training law of neural networks and establish a descent theorem for the learning operator, which serves to determine whether the operator is sufficient to characterize the learning dynamics. Then the exact closure theorem and the dynamic coarse-graining theorem are presented in sequence. The three theorems established in this paper provide a systematic framework for constructing and assessing dynamical coarse-grained models of neural-network training. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of the theorems with a finite-width nonlinear ReLU network. Its dynamic coarse-grained model for a fixed pattern is exactly derived and composed of five independent moments. The model exactly predict the training outputs and evolving learning operator. The framework may also guide the development of approximate coarse-grained models for more general neural networks when exact closure is unavailable.

AI.brief_summary: 该文为神经网络训练建立学习算子及下降定理、精确闭合定理与动态粗粒化定理，并以有限宽非线性 ReLU 网络为例，用五个独立矩构成的粗粒化模型精确预测训练输出与算子演化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其粗粒化与闭合性框架可能为压缩 LVR 内部状态、判断少量宏观量能否充分刻画推理状态演化提供概念线索，但对象是训练动力学而非推理期状态，需核查可迁移性。

title: Learning Human Sports Motion Feasibility via Quantile Regression on Tracking Data
summary: We study time-to-arrival (TTA) in sports: the shortest plausible time a player needs to reach an arbitrary location on the pitch given their current kinematic state, estimated as the lower envelope of observed locomotion times. Rather than modeling space ownership through position density estimation or closed-form physics-based models, we cast TTA as a conditional quantile regression problem, estimating the lower quantile of locomotion time so the model learns a player's lower-envelope arrival time. We train the model on optical tracking data from all 64 matches of the PFF FC FIFA World Cup 2022 dataset, and evaluate a lightweight multilayer perceptron against six player-motion models from the literature, re-expressed as TTA predictors, and a learned reachable- hull baseline. Across our evaluation metrics, the MLP consistently outperforms every physics-based baseline. To probe the generality of the learned locomotion model, we further evaluate it on basketball tracking data and a single-game NFL tracking dataset, analyzing the transferability of player motion dynamics across sports. Our project is available at https://github.com/mguti97/TTA-Quantile.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文把运动场景中球员到达任意位置的最短可行时间（TTA）建模为条件分位数回归问题，用世界杯光学跟踪数据训练轻量 MLP 去估计移动时间的下包络，并与多种物理基线和可达域基线比较，另在篮球与 NFL 数据上检验跨运动迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接联系，属于较远领域；但其以分位数回归学习「可达性下界」的做法，可能可供核查用于估计 latent 推理状态在给定预算下能否到达所需证据，从而服务停止决策与计算成本评价。

title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on reusable skills for complex software engineering tasks, making skill libraries essential for repository development and maintenance. However, repository-specific skills must evolve with changing code structures, implementation conventions, and maintenance requirements. Pull requests (PRs) provide a natural source of such knowledge by recording how repositories evolve through implementation and review. Meanwhile, new PRs must follow repository-specific implementation patterns, modify related components consistently, and ensure that existing tests continue to pass while adding coverage for new functionality. This creates a mutually reinforcing cycle: PRs provide knowledge for updating skills, while these skills improve future PRs, maintain repositories, and support further skill evolution. To enable this co-evolution of PRs, repositories, and skills, we propose Skill Dreaming, a framework that learns from PR streams to guide continuous repository development and maintenance. Given a repository and its PR history, Skill Dreaming builds a repository-specific skill library by extracting executable knowledge from validated PRs and continuously refines the skills as new PR information becomes available. These skills guide coding agents not only in implementing requested features but also in maintaining associated tests, documentation, compatibility, and repository conventions. By integrating PR analysis, skill management, code execution, and continuous integration, Skill Dreaming provides an end-to-end workflow for applying learned skills to repository changes and incorporating subsequent PR outcomes into future skill updates.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Skill Dreaming 框架，从仓库 PR 历史中抽取可执行知识，构建并持续演化仓库专用技能库，用于指导编码 agent 实现功能并同步维护测试、文档与仓库约定。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关联，但其「从已验证轨迹中抽取可复用知识并随新反馈持续更新」的闭环，可能可供核查作为 LVR 轨迹监督筛选与经验积累的类比线索，尚不涉及内部推理状态。

title: Bayesian Evidence Accumulation for Graph-Based Learning in Dynamic Data-Driven Applications Systems
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used in modern machine learning, yet most existing frameworks remain fundamentally static, limiting their applicability in Dynamic Data Driven Application Systems (DDDAS) where observations arrive sequentially under uncertainty. We introduce B-EAGLe (Bayesian Evidence Accumulation for Graph-Based Learning), a probabilistic framework inspired by CBGT-Net (cortico-basal ganglia-thalamic network) that reformulates graph classification as a sequential evidence accumulation process. B-EAGLe combines a GNN encoder with a Bayesian accumulator that incrementally updates posterior beliefs over class labels as new observations arrive, committing to a decision only when sufficient confidence is achieved. Experiments on CIFAR10 demonstrate competitive performance together with principled confidence estimation under sequential observations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 B-EAGLe：把图分类重构为序列证据累积过程，用 GNN 编码器配合 Bayesian 累加器，随观测顺序到达增量更新类标签后验，并在置信度足够时提交决策，在 CIFAR10 图上报告竞争性性能与置信度估计。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「后验信念随证据增量更新 + 置信度达标即停止」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 判据与逐步累积的证据状态提供可核查的表述与评价参考；但对象是图分类而非多模态推理，迁移需自行判断。

title: UT-HMR: Uncertainty-Guided Temporal Modeling for Robust 3D Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Monocular 3D human mesh recovery (HMR) remains unreliable under weak observations caused by long camera-to-person distances, occlusion, and motion blur. In challenging scenarios such as sports, these factors make the problem highly ambiguous, as different 3D poses may yield similar 2D projections. This ambiguity is especially severe for one-stage HMR, which recovers all meshes directly from the full image without person crops or external 2D cues. To handle this ambiguity, we present UT-HMR ( Uncertainty-guided Temporal HMR), to our knowledge the first one-stage HMR framework to capture correlated pose uncertainty across joints. Each person query predicts a Gaussian distribution over the full SMPL pose with a compact low-rank-plus-diagonal covariance, which is converted into joint-wise precision weights for heteroscedastic supervision while keeping inference deterministic. Temporal early fusion further injects neighboring-frame evidence before pose decoding, supplying the visual evidence needed to resolve the ambiguity that the uncertainty captures. With a lightweight ViT-B backbone, UT-HMR achieves state-of-the-art results on VIP-HockeyPose-v2 (ice hockey) and WorldPose (soccer), reducing MPJPE, PA-MPJPE, and PVE by up to 4.7%, 3.8%, and 5.6%, and remains competitive on 3DPW against methods with larger backbones and higher input resolutions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UT-HMR 单阶段 3D 人体网格恢复框架：每个人体 query 预测带低秩加对角协方差的全身姿态高斯分布，转为关节精度权重做异方差监督，并在解码前用时序早融合注入邻帧视觉证据以缓解弱观测歧义。
AI.relevance_reason: 「结构化协方差刻画歧义、并在解码前补入额外视觉证据」的做法，可能为 LVR 中如何用不确定状态驱动证据获取与停止决策提供类比线索；但任务与语言推理无关，借鉴需较多核查。

title: Concorde: Geometry-Aware Link Prediction via Decoupled Energy Minimization
summary: Link prediction remains difficult in sparse graphs, where diffusion heuristics lack connectivity and geometric methods suffer spectral instability when coupling learned representations with diffusion operators. We introduce Concorde, an energy-based framework that resolves this by decomposing link likelihood into three structurally decoupled branches: (i) a parameter-free spectral anchor that establishes permutation-invariant topological stability; (ii) a mixed-curvature residual on a learnable $\mathbb{H}^{d_h}_{c_h} \times \mathbb{S}^{d_s}_{c_s}$ product manifold, regularized by a feature-aware Ollivier-Ricci curvature proxy; and (iii) a continuous vector field on the tangent bundle of hyperbolic space for non-local structural alignment across topological gaps. The branches are fused via learned gating and trained with an N-pair ranking loss aligned with retrieval-style evaluation. Across five benchmarks spanning sparse, dense, featureless, and attributed regimes, Concorde establishes state-of-the-art early retrieval precision, nearly doubling P@10% over leading baselines in sparse settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Concorde，一个能量最小化框架，将链路预测分解为无参数谱锚点、混合曲率流形上的残差与双曲切丛向量场三支，经学习门控融合并用 N-pair 排序损失训练，在稀疏等图基准上提升早期检索精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其解耦分支、门控融合与乘积流形几何可能为 LVR 中多源 latent 状态的组织与结构化表示提供概念线索，但论文属图链路预测任务，与 VLM 推理及证据使用无直接联系，联系需核查。

title: BehaveRec: When Does Long-Term Behavioral History Help Sequential Recommendation? A Study with Session, History, and Community Signals
summary: Sequential recommendation models typically predict a user's next action from recent session interactions, which limits personalization when short-term signals are weak or ambiguous. Rather than assuming that incorporating longer-term history and community signals is universally beneficial, we study when it actually helps. We propose BehaveRec, a three-signal framework combining a causal session transformer, a bidirectional User History Encoder over a 90-day window, and a GraphSAGE module over a user-user graph built from behavioral embedding similarity rather than item co-occurrence; a learned gate blends the three signals per user. On an industrial dataset of 137M sequences from 12.6M users, BehaveRec improves R@5 by +3.2% over SASRec, with a larger-capacity SASRec baseline (more parameters than BehaveRec) still trailing by +2.5%, ruling out capacity as the explanation. More importantly, a user-level stratification by history length reveals a clear dose-response relationship: BehaveRec's advantage is negligible below roughly 10 interactions and grows monotonically with history richness, reaching +0.017 R@5 for users with 101+ events. This pattern is corroborated across one industrial and three public datasets spanning history-rich to history-sparse regimes, where session-only models remain preferable. These headline results, and the resulting deployment threshold, are established for category-level intent prediction; a preliminary, single-run check on the full item-level vocabulary yields a directionally mixed result and is scoped as an open question rather than a claim. We use these results to derive a practical deployment rule -- roughly 20 interactions per user -- for when long-term history and behavioral-graph signals are worth their added complexity. Despite this added complexity, BehaveRec remains lightweight: it uses 5.67M parameters and trains on a single GPU in under two days.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BehaveRec，将因果会话 Transformer、90 天双向用户历史编码器与基于行为相似度用户图的 GraphSAGE 三路信号用可学习门控融合，并按用户历史长度分层分析长程历史究竟何时带来收益，据此给出部署阈值。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按历史丰富度分层的「剂量—响应」分析与收益阈值，可供核查如何评估额外视觉证据或更长 latent 推理在何种条件下才值得其成本；但属推荐系统，无视觉或内部推理状态，迁移可能需较多改造。

title: Three Worlds for the Price of a Logarithm: Baseline-Protected Best-of-Both-Worlds Combinatorial Semi-Bandits
summary: Improving on a baseline requires exploring away from it, precisely where its performance may be lost. We propose DUET (Doubling Under Empirical Tests), a horizon-free phased mixing scheme for combinatorial semi-bandits with arbitrary finite action sets. Two observable tests decide when to double the learning weight and when to double the empirical-regret budget and restart. We instantiate the scheme with entropy-FTRL in mixed phases and hybrid-FTRL in pure phases. Assuming the baseline selects every arm with positive probability, this instantiation keeps expected baseline regret logarithmic in $T$, while its expected regret to every fixed action is $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ under non-anticipating adversarial losses and polylogarithmic, gap-dependent, under i.i.d. losses with a unique optimal action. All three guarantees hold at every deterministic horizon, and the algorithm knows neither the horizon, nor the gap, nor the environment type. Baseline protection, adversarial robustness, and stochastic adaptivity thus come from one scheme and two base learners, at the price of a logarithm.
